Thanks Dan — good Qs. Short answers (high level):

- The $200–$350/1M tokens band in the model is for our Hosted SKU at standard commitment levels (no Dedicated reserved capacity). Dedicated pricing (reserved pools) typically moves the effective $/1M lower but requires a committed spend (we included a sample Dedicated scenario in tab 'Reserved' of the spreadsheet).
- We bill on billable tokens = input + output per API request. For the summarization jobs we count the entire prompt + output. That said, several levers can reduce billable tokens: prefix caching, KV cache reuse across similar requests, and truncation strategies for long contexts if acceptable. The model includes an example cache hit rate sensitivity table.

I updated the spreadsheet with a hosted vs dedicated comparison and a column that shows target $/1M tokens under your stated volumes. See attached updated RD-ACME-pricing-model-20260228.xlsx (v1.1).

Also copying Rishi — he’ll put together the invoice estimate with two line items: monthly usage estimate and a one-time onboarding fee (if you need SSO connector / VPC setup).
